question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa ow’abaana abato alina ennyiriri bbiri ez’ebizimbiso nga zirimu omuwendo gwe gumu, naye ng’ennnyiriri emu efaanana ng’eri mpanvu okusinga endala olw’okuba ebizimbiso byawukanye. Omu ku baana ajja eri omusomesa n’agamba nti, ‘Musawo, olunyiriri luno lulina ebizimbiso bingi okusinga olulala.’ Okusinziira ku tteeka lya J. Piaget, ndowooza ki eyoleka endowooza y’omwana eno?

Omwana, ng’atambula ne kitaawe mu nkuba, atunula waggulu mu ggulu n’alaga ebire ng’agamba: ‘Ebire byeraliikirivu, y’ensonga lwaki bikaaba.’ Okusinziira ku Jean Piaget mu nkola ye ey’obwongo, kiki ekiraga endowooza y’omwana eno?

Mu kibiina ky’abaana abato, abalenzi n’abawala bali mu kusiiga ebifaananyi n’ekkalaka ku lusuku lw’essomero. Fabián agamba omusomesa nti tayagala kusiiga kubanga ekkalaka eya pinki y’esigaddewo ate nga pinki bbala lya bawala. Omusomesa amugamba nti langi za buli muntu, si za balenzi oba abawala bokka, era alina okugezaako okusiiga nayo nga abasiizi bwe bakola. Mu butonde bw’omuntu, ndaga ki okusomesa kuno kwe kuyambako okukulaakulanya?
answer_c: Obuntu bw'omuntu obukwata ku by'okukwatagana kw'abantu ng'abaami n'abakyala

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Omusomesa ategeka omukolo oguyitibwa 'omutongole ow'olwaleero', ogw'omwana, buli lunaku, okugabana n'abayizi banne byayagala, ebyo byasiraamu, n'eby'amasanyu bye yayagalira ddala okuyita mu bifaananyi, ebintu byajjukira, ebizannyisibwa, n'enjogera ezirimu obumanyirivu. Musingi ki ogw'obusomesa oguliwo mu mbeera eyo waggulu?

Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okuna ng’ali n’abayizi be ku ddembe ly’abaana abalaga embeera eno: “Anita yakubwa omutwe ennyo bwe yagwa okuva ku siriidi ng’azannya ne banne mu luggya lw’essomero. Oluvannyuma lw’akabenje, Anita yatwalibwa mangu omusomesa we mu ddwaaliro, gy’afunira obujjanjabi obwetaagisa.” Oluvannyuma, omusomesa asaba abayizi okutegeera eddembe Anita ly’akozesa mu mbeera eyo era oluvannyuma, okuleeta embeera endala omutwalirwa eddembe lye limu. Ku biraga ebiri wammanga, kiraga ki ekikulu okukebereza okuyiga kw’abayizi mu mulimu ogwo omusomesa gw’aleese?
answer_b: Balaga eby'obuyinza bye bakozesa mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo nga bakozesa eby'okulabirako ebifaako.
answer_c: Bakola endowooza ku bukulu bw’okukola dduyiro n’okukuuma eddembe lyabwe
answer_d: Bategeera ebiseera ebyo eddembe ly'abaana we lityoboolerwa.

question: Omusomesa ategeka omulimu omuli abalenzi n’abawala mu kibinja kye mwe banaakyalirwa ekibiina ekisooka okuva mu ssomero. Bwe banaatuuka, buli mwana owa pulayimale anaatuula ku lusegere lw’omwana ow’ekibiina ekisooka, era bakubirizibwa okumanyigana nga bayita mu kwogera. Oluvannyuma, bajja kukola omukono ogw’okusiiga awamu era bafulume mu luggya okugabana emizannyo. Mu nkomerero, bajja kwogera mu kibinja ekinene ku byo bye bayiseemu awamu. Mu nsonga z’obuyigiriza eziddirira, nsonga ki ey’obuyigiriza ekulizibwaamu nnyo mu bumanyirivu buno obw’okuyiga?

Okusinziira ku muzannyo ng’ekikolwa eky’omubiri ekitegekeddwa, myaka ki omuntu weetaaga okutuukiriza ekimu ku bintu ebikulu eby’omuzannyo, nga kino kiba kwenyigira ng’omuntu kinnoomu okusinga okukolera awamu?

Mu bawandiisi abanoonyereza ku nkulaakulana y’ebinywa, ani ku bo ng’ayogera ku nkulaakulana y’omubiri mu bitundu bina okuva ku mubiri ogukolerawo ebintu okutuuka ku mubiri ogukiikirira okuva ku myaka 0 okutuuka ku 12?
Mu birowoozo bino ebikulu, kiki ekiraga omukwano ogw’amazima wakati w’enkulakulana y’omukwano n’emikwano gy’omu maaso; okusinziira ku Bowlby's theory?
answer_a: Abantu abakulaakulanya enkolagana ey’okwegattako n’omulabirizi atali maama omuzaazi tebasinga kuteekawo nkolagana za bwesige.
answer_b: Abantu abalabirirwa abalabirizi abakyusa obungi bw’obujjanjabi bwe bawa mu myaka egy’obuto balaga okukulaakulana okw’amaanyi mu bwetwaze bw’enneewulira.
answer_c: Abantu ababa n’abantu be banyumattira nabo nga bakyali bato bayinza okutandikawo emikwano emirungi egibatereeza naye batera okukula nga tebeesiga bantu.
answer_d: Abantu abataakulaakulanya mukwano mu myaka egyasooka mu bulamu balaga omutindo ogw’okunoonya obuyambi n’okubeera okumpi, wamu n’okwolesa enneewulira, ka zibeere nnungi oba mbi.

question:
Enkola eno yakozesebwa nnyo mu kusomesa abaana abato nga bayita mu kunoonyereza ku bintu eby’enjawulo ebyakolebwa abantu abakulu nga bakozesa ebintu eby’enjawulo gamba ng’ebyawandiikidwa, ebifaananyi, ne vidiyo. Abaana nabo beenyigira mu kunoonyereza kuno nga boogera ku byo baagala, enkaayana zaabwe, ebyabatuukako, n’embeera endala nnyingi eziyinza okuyambako okusalawo ku nsonga z’okusomesa era nga kiyamba okukulaakulanya engeri zaabwe.
Nteekateeka y’ebisomesebwa ki eyogerwako mu mutundu ogwo waggulu?

Omusomesa mu kibiina ky'abaana abato asomera akabinja ke ak'abaana abalenzi n'abawala olugero 'Ennyenje Enjala Ennyo', balukubaganyaako ebirowoozo, oluvannyuma n'abagamba bakole omulimu ogw'okwanjula ebikwata ku mmere ennungi n'embi n'ebivaamu. Okukola kino, agabanya ekibiina mu bubinja bubiri obutono: akamu kajja kukola olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emmere ennungi n'akalala, olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emmere embi. Okumaliriza, banjula wamu era bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku by'ebafunye.

Kuyiga ki omulimu guno gwe gukutiriza okusinga mu baana?

Ekibiina ky’abaana abakulu mu senaali kirimu abaana kkumi. Bonna batambula n’obuvumu era banyumirwa ebikolwa eby’okutambula. Batandise okulaga okwagala mu kusoomoozebwa gamba ng’okutikka, okukweka, okutuuma, n’okugatta ebintu. N’olwekyo, omusomesa ateekateeka okukwata ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga bino wammanga: “Okwegezaamu ebintu nga bakola ku mbeera eziriwo ddala, gamba ng’okutuuka ku bintu, okunyiga obutambi ku byuma ebivuga, okuggya ebizannyisibwa mu bintu bye biterekebwamu, okukung’aanya ebintu, n’ebirala” era “Okulaga okwagala n’okumatira nga batambula awatali buzibu mu mbeera eza bulijjo n’emizannyo”. Nga twetegerezza empisa z’ekibiina ky’abaana bano, nkola ki ey’okuyiga eyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okukwata ku bigendererwa ebyo ebirondeddwa?
answer_a: Omuzannyo ogw'okukebera: abaana bakebera, bakwatakwata era bagatta ebintu, nga bazuula ensi ku sipiidi yaabwe.
answer_b: Omutendera gw'ebyemizannyo: abaana bamaliriza omusinde ogw'ebizibu eby'enjawulo, nga bagoberera enteekateeka entongole.
answer_c: Akabba ka byabugagga: abaana bakebera nga batuula okwetooloola akabba akajjuziddwa ebintu ebya bulijjo n'ebyo ebirondeddwa
answer_d: Ekifo ky'ebyamazina: abaana bazannya, batambulatambula era bakolagana n'ebintu ebirabika obulungi ebiterekeddwa mu kifo.

question:
Omusomesa yeetaaga okulonda ekyuma eky’omulembe ekisobozesa empuliziganya wakati w’abali mu buli kibinja era naye; ekisobozesa okugabana n’okukyusa ebiwandiiko mu budde bwennyini; era nga kisobola okuteekawo emirimu n’okugigabira buli muntu mu kibinja.
Kiki ku bintu bino wammanga ekisinga okutuukana n’ebyo omusomesa byetaaga?
answer_a: Akataffeesi ak'omukutu ogwa kompyuta akagabanyizibwako emikutu gya yintaneeti nga Symbaloo
answer_b: Enkola y'okukozesa okuteesa ebirowoozo nga Stormboard
answer_c: Enkola y'okutereka ebipapula ku intaneeti nga Google Drive
answer_d: Omukutu ogw'okukyusa endowooza nga okukozesa ebifaananyi, okufaanana nga Marqueed

question: Soma okunnyonnyola kuno wammanga: Emu ku ndowooza ze ezisinga obukulu mu by’enjigiriza y’enjogera y’Obumanyirivu Obutabaganyiziddwa (Mediated Learning Experience - MLE), obukyusakyusa mu bwongo bw’omuntu mwe busibuka. MLE kitegeeza omutindo gw’enkolagana y’omuntu n’obwetooloole bwe, omuli okunnyonnyola engeri obwongo gye bukola ng’ekivaamu okusaasaanya obuwangwa. Okusinziira ku ndowooza eno, enkola y’okutabaganya etwalibwa ng’eyongera ku busobozi bw’omuntu okutuuka ku njigiriza ey’omugaso, ng’okutegeera nti okuyita mu yo, omuntu asobola okukyusa enjigiriza etuukiddwaako mu mbeera enjawulo era n’asobola okugikozesa mu mbeera oba embeera endala, ng’ekubiriza okuggya obumanyirivu bw’omuntu ku bubwe mu njigiriza empya. Mu bawandiisi abalondeddwa wammanga, ani alowoozebwa okuba n’enjogera eno ku nkola y’okuyigiriza n’okuyiga eyannyonnyolwa mu mutundu oguweddeko?

Omusomesa w'ekibiina ekyokusatu, mu kitundu ekikwata ku ddembe ly'abaana, yalonda ekitundu kino okuva mu lubalo *Omuwala Ataalina Erinnya*, olwa Saúl Schkolnik, okutandika okukolera awamu n'abayizi be ku ddembe ly'okumanyika: Waaliwo omuwala ataali na linnya lyonna. Si nti yalina erinnya eryewuunyisa, oba erimu okwogera kyazibu, oba erimu ku mannya ago amakadde ennyo, oba mpozzi ery'amawanga... Nedda! Yali talina linnya lyonna. Eky'amazima kiri nti, omuntu bw'aba nga ye Maria era omuntu n'ayita: —Maria! Omuntu akoola endabika ya Maria era n'addamu: —Ani ampita? Naye, omuntu bw'aba nga talina linnya lyonna, olwo tasobola kukola ndabika y'omuntu... Era ebintu bitandika okubula okutuusa omuntu lw'akomawo ng'atalina matu. Ku bibuuzo bino wammanga, kibuuzo ki omusomesa ky'ayinza okubuuza okukwataganya butereevu ebyasomeddwa n'eddembe erigenda okusomebwa mu kibiina?
answer_a: Kiki ku bikwata ku muwala ali mu lubalo ekikukutte ennyo omwoyo n'olwaki?
answer_b: Kitu ky’olowooza nti kissaanye n’eddembe ly’abaana mu lugero luno?
answer_c: Olowooza kiki ekiyinza okuba nga kye kyavaamu omuwala mu lugero okubula erinnya?
answer_d: Engeri ki emboozi gy’eyinza okuggwamu mu ngeri ennungi eri omuwala ali mu mboozi?

question: Omusomesa w'abaana abato, oluvannyuma lw'okukebera okuzuula obuzibu, ateekateeka engeri z'okusomesa ezisobozesa ekibinja ky'abalenzi n'abawala okwogera ku nneewulira zaabwe. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, y'eriwa etuukana n'ekigendererwa ky'omusomesa?
answer_a: Muzannye omuzannyo ogw’ekigambo era musabe abalenzi n’abawala okulaga enneewulira emboozi gy’ebaleetera.
answer_b: Saba abalenzi n'abawala okujjukira n'okusiiga ebifaananyi by'embeera ezabaleetera engeri z'ebiwuubaalo ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Muzannye omukube gw'ebipimo by'emyoyo, musabe abalenzi n'abawala okuguyiringisa n'okwatuukiriza erinnya ly'omwoyo oguvaamu.
answer_d: Baliriza abalenzi n'abawala okuzina, nga balaga enneewulira ezitali zimu nga bwe ziggwayo mu luyimba.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina kya ‘kindergarten’ ategese ekibiina mu bifo eby’emizannyo era ng’ayongeddeko ebintu ebipya eby’okukozesa ebisensa, gamba ng’emmeeza z’amazzi, ekitangaala, omusenyu, n’ensigo. Abaana balaze essanyu lingi okuzannya n’ebintu ebipya; kyokka, wabaddewo obutakkaanya wakati waabwe nga babikozesa. Nga tutunuulira omutendera gw’abayizi, engeri ki ku zino wammanga esinga okukulaakulanya obumu mu baana?
answer_a: Omusomesa yeegatta ku bazannyi b'abaana ng'ayingira mu kutereeza enkaayana ezibaawo era ng'alaga enkozesa entuufu ey'ebikozesebwa.
answer_b: Omusomesa akolawo akabanga ak’okwogera n’abaana okuzimba endagaano ku ngeri y’okukozesa ebikozesebwa n’okugonjoola enkaayana mu mirembe.
answer_c: Omusomesa assaawo amateeka agafaanagana ku ngeri y’okukozesa ebikozesebwa ebipya mu biseera by’okuzannya era abajjukiza buli kiseera okukutumbula obumu.
answer_d: Omusomesa akola enteekateeka ey’okukyusa ebibinja ng’akozesa ebibinja ebitono eby’abazannyi okwewala enkaayana n’okukutanya emirembe mu banno.

question: Omusomesa omukulu ow’ekika kya Siniya Kinda gaddemu alambise ekigendererwa kino okuva mu mutima gw’okubeera awamu n’obumannyi: "Okutegeera ebikolwa ebituufu n’ebikyamu olw’okubeera awamu mu ngeri entuufu mu kibinja, ebyolekeddwa mu mbeera ez’enjawulo ezabulijjo n’emizannyo". Okutuuka ku kino, mu bbanga ly’okwogera, bateekateeka amateeka agafuga okubeera awamu okuzuula eby’okukola ku buzibu obw’enjawulo obubaawo mu bannaabwe. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyayogerwa?
answer_a: Mu kiseera ky’okwaniriza, omusomesa abuuza ku mateeka, era Rafael agamba: "Olina okutambulira munda mu kibiina so si kudduka."
answer_b: Mu budde bw'emmere, Daniela alya ku mmere ya munne, era akaaba. Ignacia, bw'amulaba nga akaaba, agenda eri omusomesa n'amugamba: "Munnange yeetaaga obuyambi."
answer_c: Mu biseera by’okuzannya obwereere, Matías atunuulira Alejandro ng’azannya loole, oluvannyuma n’amusemberera, n’amuggyako eky’okuzannya n’agamba: “kati ge magezi gange, omusomesa yagambye tulina okugabana.”
answer_d: Mu biseera by'okukola mu bitundu, Leonor ne Sebastián basuula ebikondo by'emiti okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala mu kisulo. Agustín abasemberera n'abagamba: "Temusaanye kukola ekyo, muyinza okututomera ebikondo."

question: Bikugu ki ebikuzibwa mu bawala n'abalenzi okuyita mu mizannyo egikolerwa mu mateeka?
answer_a: Okubonero kw'embeera ezibaawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.
answer_b: Okutegeera obulungi embeera z'abalala n'okumalawo obutakkaanya
answer_c: Ebintu ebiyamba mu mbeera z'obukulembeze okuli okukkiriziganya n'okukyusakyusa mu mirimu.
answer_d: Okuyiga emicito n'obuvunaanyizibwa ebiteekeddwawo mu nsi
